Curiosity with care

Take experiences seriously.
Keep explanations open.

Why we built Anomalous Accounts

We bring together extraordinary human experiences to explore patterns, discover connections, and build an open research resource for anyone seeking a better understanding of the anomalous.

What we mean by "Anomalous"

We welcome UAP sightings, entity encounters, near-death experiences, psi experiences, altered states, and other unexplained events. Psi includes apparent telepathy, precognition, and remote perception; altered states can include meditation, dreams, and unitive experiences. Categories can overlap and do not imply a shared cause.

Sharing your experience

Tell us what happened in your own words. Include the context, note uncertainties, and distinguish observations from interpretations. Supporting photos, recordings, or documents are welcome when available. Submissions are for adults 18 and older.

Understanding the data

Approved reports contribute to the open archive and its patterns. Review checks suitability for publication; it does not verify an experience or its explanation.

The data describes this collection of self-reported accounts. Patterns can suggest useful questions, but cannot establish causes or how common an experience is in the wider population. Counts represent reports, not necessarily different people or events.

Your privacy and choices

No name, email, or account is required to submit. Approved structured answers appear in the archive and data downloads. Your written narrative and supporting links are published only if you separately opt in to share them. Avoid identifying details about yourself or others.

Withdrawal and private concern handling must be connected before this version accepts reports. Copies already downloaded by others cannot be recalled. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Open Research Dataset

Download the approved accounts in the current selection. Updates appear when the reviewed public dataset is refreshed. Review is not verification; these reports do not establish a shared cause or population prevalence.

Privacy Policy

What you share

Anomalous Accounts collects the account, structured answers, and supporting links you submit. We accept submissions only from people aged 18 or older. Please avoid exact addresses, names, medical records, and information identifying other people. A narrative, location, or linked file may identify you even without your name.

Technical information

Not asking for your name does not guarantee anonymity. Hosting providers and externally loaded fonts may receive connection information such as your IP address. Avoid identifying details in reports and linked files.

Who can see your report

After review, structured answers answers (date, broad location, categories, signatures, setting, witness count) are made available publicly for research charting and open CSV downloads. Your narrative is published only if you explicitly choose the full-account sharing option.

Withdrawal and concerns

This file does not yet provide a connected withdrawal service. Submission is paused until private review, withdrawal, and concern handling are connected. Removal from this site cannot recall copies downloaded by others or guarantee removal from repository history.

Updated September 25, 2026

Submission Terms

Eligibility and agreement

You must be at least 18 to submit. Describe your experience honestly, distinguish observations from interpretations, and note uncertainty. You do not need to establish a particular explanation.

Permission to use your submission

You retain ownership of your original observations. You grant Anomalous Accounts nonexclusive permission to store, review, and display approved structured answers for research and public analysis. Full text and supporting links may be published only with your separate permission. Submit only material you have the right to share; do not include harassment, threats, or identifying information about others.

Informational purpose

Accounts are self-reported; approval is not verification. This site does not provide medical care or emergency assistance. Do not stop treatment or undertake unsafe activities based on reports.

Privacy / copyright concerns

Private concern handling is not connected in this version. This form does not send messages. Do not enter sensitive information here.

This service must be connected before submissions reopen.

Withdraw your report

Withdrawal is not connected in this version. No removal request will be sent by this form.

Owner workspace

Review submissions

This is a reviewer checklist, not an authenticated review queue. Private submissions must be reviewed in the protected backend; never publish the intake sheet or owner credentials here.

Approve only after checking the account and every structured field. Approval places structured answers into the archive and live research download.

Review checklist

  1. Privacy: Verify no personal names, addresses, or private contact info appear in text fields.
  2. Possible duplicates: Compare dates, broad places, and descriptions. Reports may describe the same event.
  3. Quality: Confirm report meets publication rules and distinguishes observation from speculation.
  4. Full Narrative Permission: Check whether contributor checked full narrative publication.
